prompts.habitats:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original pixel-art environment sprite sheet for a playable top-down miniature forest experiment.
Primary request: SIX separate charming homes made by tiny pointy-hatted forest elves from found natural materials. These are NOT human cottages. Each elf is only about 8 cm tall. The doors are tiny compared with the found objects. A human shoe becomes an entire inn.
Style/medium: exceptional hand-crafted 16-bit top-down RPG pixel art, visible clean clustered square pixels, consistent high 3/4 overhead camera looking north onto south-facing entrances, no perspective horizon, flat orthographic game sprites. Expressive asymmetrical silhouettes, restrained moss/sage green, cinnamon bark, honey light, faded indigo and terracotta accents. Material-rich but legible at 128px per sprite. No existing franchise designs.
Composition: a precise 3 columns by 2 rows grid on a 1536 by 1024 TRANSPARENT canvas; each isolated sprite centered inside its own 512 by 512 cell, with at least 40px empty padding. No grid lines. No overlap between cells. No scenic background, terrain tile or shadow rectangle. Genuinely transparent RGBA background, not white, not checkerboard.
Top left: old worn brown leather human ankle boot lying on its side, turned into a cozy elf inn, little leaf awning over tiny carved door at the toe, laces become a handrail, a tiny warm window in the leather side.
Top middle: tall hollow weathered oak stump with magnificent spreading roots, tiny round door nestled low between the roots, two little amber windows, shelf mushrooms make steps and roof.
Top right: a woven twig shelter, roof made of overlapping enormous green leaves with distinct veins, tied vine joints, tiny door and acorn lantern.
Bottom left: huge ochre and cinnamon bolete mushroom with a tiny door in the thick white stem and a small twig balcony under the cap, irregular natural mushroom cap, not a conventional house.
Bottom middle: sideways fallen hollow log converted to a workshop with little leaf roof panels, warm doorway at its sawn end, acorn cup planters, bark textures.
Bottom right: a cracked discarded terracotta flowerpot lying sideways, fern-frond canopy, tiny twig door inside the opening, a small spiral root stair, cozy amber light.
Constraints: exactly six separate sprites, single coherent pixel grid and perspective, no people, no text, no labels, no watermark, no masonry human houses. Preserve ample transparent gaps. Draw the found-object houses boldly and beautifully, not generic clipart.
prompts.nature:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: modular environment sprite sheet for an original top-down pixel-art game at tiny-elf scale.
Primary request: SIX beautiful oversized forest objects, as seen by an 8-centimeter-tall elf. Natural objects must feel architectural and monumental, with crisp, readable silhouettes. This is a companion set for homes made from boots, hollow roots, leaves and mushrooms.
Style/medium: very polished hand-crafted 16-bit RPG pixel art, visible uniform square pixel clusters, no painterly blur, no outlines in pure black. High 3/4 overhead orthographic camera looking toward the north; south-facing objects. Moss green, muted jade, honey highlights, warm auburn bark, creamy mushroom stems; same light upper-left in every sprite. Readable at 160px native size.
Composition: exact 3 columns by 2 rows grid on a 1536 by 1024 genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA canvas. One isolated object centered inside each 512 by 512 cell, at least 32px clear padding, no overlapping cells, no grid lines, no background scenery or terrain slabs. Transparent means alpha, not checkerboard.
Top left: a monumental ancient oak base and its rising thick trunk, big curling exposed roots creating archways, moss and little shelf mushrooms, broken upper trunk disappears behind a small mass of foliage. NOT a miniature whole christmas tree. The roots are like cliffs at tiny scale.
Top middle: a large cluster of arching emerald fern fronds, detailed leaflets in elegant asymmetric sweeping silhouettes, one curled fiddlehead.
Top right: three huge round clover leaves on slender stems, a dew bead on one leaf, arranged like a sheltering canopy.
Bottom left: one stout chestnut bolete mushroom with a broad buttery brown cap and creamy tapered stalk, two smaller companions at its foot, no doors or windows.
Bottom middle: a broad curving fallen branch with gnarled bark and exposed root ends forming a natural small arch or bridge, sparse moss tufts, extremely clear silhouette.
Bottom right: three scarlet woodland mushrooms of unequal heights with warm cream flecks and pale gills, finely readable stems, small green leaf at base.
Constraints: exactly six separate sprites, original designs, no characters, no text, no labels, no watermarks, no houses. Keep all natural objects complete with ample transparent space. Coherent pixel grid and game camera, not isometric diamonds or front-facing clipart.
prompts.concept:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: art-direction keyframe for an original playable top-down pixel-art tiny-elf forest. Landscape 1536 by 1024.
Primary request: Show how extraordinary an ordinary forest becomes for an eight-centimeter-tall pointy-eared elf. Beautiful sophisticated original 16-bit pixel art game environment, not an interface mockup. Clear high 3/4 overhead orthographic RPG camera with no horizon. The terrain occupies the entire image.
Scene: a little elf hamlet nestled between the monumental exposed roots of an ancient oak and a vast turquoise river that runs out of frame to the right; the distant shore is NOT visible. A worn human leather boot has become an inn with an acorn lamp and tiny leaf awning. A tiny warm entrance in the enormous tree root leads home. Two smaller shelters are woven from branches and overlapping leaves. An ochre mushroom is taller than a villager and forms a natural umbrella. Huge ferns and clover leaves shade the uneven moss floor. Paths are narrow softened trails through moss and leaf litter, curving sensibly between tiny doors rather than human roads. A little driftwood landing and a curled leaf boat at the river's edge. One overlooked brass button among the roots makes scale instantly clear.
Characters: three tiny distinct cheerful pointy-eared elves, all wearing long floppy pointed hats, one plum, one rust, one blue; expressive pixel silhouettes only about 28px tall within the full scene, much smaller than the boot and mushrooms. One protagonist by the boot entrance and two distant neighbors, not a crowd.
Style: exceptionally clear cohesive pixel clusters, deliberately restrained detail, soft jade/fern/olive greens, warm ochre and cinnamon bark, dusky turquoise water with subtle ripples, small amber window glows. Sun filtering through giant unseen leaves, broad quiet shadows, warm playful relaxing fairy-tale mood. Scenic composition with a clear traversable foreground and rich scale cues. No human-sized stone or timber cottages, no tiled plaza, no castles.
Constraints: entirely original designs, no franchise references, no text, no UI, no labels, no logos or watermark. This is game-scale concept art: clear readable tiny characters and outsized natural materials are essential.
